scope_fields.counterexample: Normal singular quadric threefold X={x0*x3-x1*x2=0} in P4_C, dimension of subvarieties d=2
scope_fields.generator_restrictions: Counterexample still holds with only smooth or only lci ample generators on this singular ambient X
scope_fields.numerical_equivalence: Chern-polynomial numerical equivalence, including on singular varieties, as in Fulger-Lehmann section 2.1.2
scope_fields.source_scope_warning: OWR introduction defines ampleness for smooth subvarieties of complex projective manifolds; Problem 1(1) does not restate the ambient assumptions. Do not mark the intended smooth-ambient question solved on this evidence.
scope_fields.review_status: Scoped counterexample and normal codimension-one criterion accepted by the accompanying independent AI-assisted mathematical audit; unrefereed
scope_fields.general_criterion: For normal integral projective T over C, dim(T)>=2, the positive cone generated by integral codimension-one Ottem-ample subvarieties equals the image of Amp(T) in N_(n-1)(T), and is open in the full numerical space iff that map is surjective.
scope_fields.general_criterion_generator_scope: All integral centers; no general smooth-only claim on arbitrary singular varieties
optional_enhancements_included: Independent elementary-transform vector-bundle separation by second Chern degrees, already proved in the accepted audit

reason: Actual PR body, README and STATUS accept a normal SINGULAR quadric-threefold counterexample and normal codimension-one Cartier-to-Weil criterion, explicitly leaving the original smooth-ambient workshop problem unresolved. N2(X)=R2 but the positive ample-surface cone is the ray R>0(1,1); smooth/lci generators do not make X smooth. This is codimension one, not a separately strictly higher-codimension counterexample. The general criterion uses all integral centers, without a general smooth-generator assertion. Neither relative topology, cone closure, zero inclusion nor another positivity cone is substituted for the target. Known Ottem/Fulger-Lehmann inputs credited, no novelty/priority claim; exact checks and optional Chern-test exposition do not resolve the original smooth question.
duplicate_check: Not required for this ineligible partial/prior application claim; no substantive proof/priority audit or publication performed.
